factors.name: factor_volume_exhaustion_reversal
factors.description: 放量下跌后量能衰竭的短期反转研究候选。
factors.code:
def factor_volume_exhaustion_reversal(df):
    ordered = df.copy().sort_values(['instrument', 'date'])
    grouped = ordered.groupby('instrument', group_keys=False)
    ret_3d = grouped['close'].pct_change(3)
    vol_avg_20d = grouped['volume'].transform(lambda s: s.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean())
    volume_shock = ordered['volume'] / vol_avg_20d.replace(0, np.nan)
    volume_decay = -grouped['volume'].pct_change(3)
    values = (-ret_3d) * volume_shock * volume_decay.clip(lower=0)
    values = values.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return values.reindex(df.index)

factors.name: factor_multiscale_trend_consistency
factors.description: 短中期方向一致并经历史波动调整的趋势研究候选。
factors.code:
def factor_multiscale_trend_consistency(df):
    ordered = df.copy().sort_values(['instrument', 'date'])
    grouped = ordered.groupby('instrument', group_keys=False)
    ret_5d = grouped['close'].pct_change(5)
    ret_20d = grouped['close'].pct_change(20)
    daily_ret = grouped['close'].pct_change()
    volatility_20d = daily_ret.groupby(ordered['instrument']).transform(lambda s: s.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std())
    consistency = (np.sign(ret_5d) == np.sign(ret_20d)).astype(float)
    values = ret_5d / volatility_20d.replace(0, np.nan) * consistency
    values = values.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return values.reindex(df.index)

factors.name: factor_lower_shadow_volume_absorption
factors.description: 放量长下影并收于日内高位的卖压吸收研究候选。
factors.code:
def factor_lower_shadow_volume_absorption(df):
    ordered = df.copy().sort_values(['instrument', 'date'])
    grouped = ordered.groupby('instrument', group_keys=False)
    price_range = (ordered['high'] - ordered['low']).replace(0, np.nan)
    lower_shadow = np.minimum(ordered['open'], ordered['close']) - ordered['low']
    lower_shadow_ratio = lower_shadow / price_range
    close_location = (ordered['close'] - ordered['low']) / price_range
    vol_avg_20d = grouped['volume'].transform(lambda s: s.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean())
    volume_shock = ordered['volume'] / vol_avg_20d.replace(0, np.nan)
    values = lower_shadow_ratio.clip(lower=0) * close_location.clip(0, 1) * volume_shock
    values = values.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return values.reindex(df.index)
